reviews.text: There was a power outage in part of our house, and he rectified it right away. He told us what went wrong and how he fixed it. Service that is really honest and dependable. Strongly recommended!
They did a great job rewiring our house. The team was well-organised, skilled, and left the property clean. Very happy with the outcome.

I thought the technician was very careful. He carefully found the problem, told me what to do, and made sure everything was tried before he left. His honesty and skill made him stand out, and I had full faith in his work.
A 220V outlet was necessary for the dryer in our laundry area. After a thorough installation, the electrician demonstrated how to use the breaker and double-checked his work.
When they installed my electrical sockets and switches, the crew was fantastic. They worked quickly, meticulously, and expertly. I really suggest it!

Had a car charger installed for our EV. The electrician helped us choose the right spot in the garage, got the permit taken care of, and handled everything like a pro. Charging is now fast and seamless.
Had a buzzing sound coming from the wall, and the electrician figured it out in minutes. Turns out it was a bad outlet, which he replaced immediately. Clean, fast, and professional work.

Completely happy with the electrician's performance. The light fixture was repaired, and I double-checked that it was done correctly. After such a wonderful experience, I intend to hire them again later this year to replace my electrical panel.

Really pleased with the work done by this local electrical company. It looks terrific when he put in the new light fixture. It took a lot of courage for me to let him inside my home, but he did a great job and was very kind to boot.

In my three years of employment with this organization, I have never encountered a problem. They handle every power restoration in my neighborhood, and they always complete it swiftly and effectively. I would strongly advise anyone looking for power restoration to use this company.
Great service and top-quality work!

This business was the one I decided to reach out to when I realized I needed help with some household tasks. A perfect example of punctuality, friendliness, and thoughtfulness in any situation. Repairs to the outlets and switches were faultless. Good job! I appreciate your help a great deal.

I'm relieved to have located this trustworthy local electrician. In spite of my rushed appointment, they were able to get me in to fix my faulty plugs and switches. I thought I'd have to wait weeks before they came back out, but they actually came out the very next day!

We contacted a local electrician to restore power to a faulty wall outlet and light switch. They showed up on schedule, determined the issue, and fixed it effectively. If you need any electrical repair done, I suggest calling a local electrician.
They did a fantastic job installing outdoor lights. The company was great to work with and responded quickly when we had questions. Would highly recommend!
They improved my home's lighting, and I wouldn't consider using any other company after working with eSparks Electricals. I advise you to try their service. I promise you won’t be disappointed.
He installed my light fixture was professional and courteous, and his rate was lower than any other estimate I had received. That's why I'd suggest it.
I am quite satisfied with the new outside light I bought from this firm. The installation process was straightforward, and the final product looks amazing.
Amazing service all around!! Quick, responsive and above all expectations.  If I have any additional  issues, they will be my first call
I had a wonderful experience with this company. The technicians were skilled and provided valuable solutions.
